name: medical-research-assistant
description: AI-powered medical research assistant using RAG, Sentence-BERT, FAISS, and Gemini 2.5 Flash. Live demo available.

paragraphs: An AI-powered medical research assistant that retrieves peer-reviewed research papers and generates grounded, cited answers using RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) architecture.

Medical professionals and researchers often need quick, reliable answers backed by peer-reviewed literature. This application allows users to ask any medical question and receive a comprehensive answer grounded in real PubMed research papers — complete with citations and direct links to the source articles.

This project demonstrates a production-grade RAG pipeline built entirely from scratch, combining semantic search, transformer-based embeddings, and a large language model to deliver accurate, cited medical information.
features: Semantic Search — finds relevant papers by meaning, not just keywords, using Sentence-BERT embeddings
Real PubMed Data — knowledge base built from 242 peer-reviewed medical research papers across 5 medical domains
Cited Answers — every answer includes citations with author names, publication years, and direct PubMed links
Fast Retrieval — FAISS vector index returns top 5 relevant papers in milliseconds
Clean UI — two-column layout showing the AI answer alongside the retrieved source papers
